original: ふぅ。\n困ったね……
traducao: Phew.\nThis is quite a dilemma...

original: そうだね……
traducao: That's true...

original: あれ、二人ともどうしたの？\n何かあった？
traducao: Huh, what's wrong with you two?\nDid something happen?

original: あ、シング
traducao: Oh, Shing.

original: 実はさっき、差出人の\n名前がない依頼が届いたの
traducao: Actually, we just got a request\nwithout a sender's name on it.

original: 名前がない依頼？
traducao: A request without a name?

original: よっぽど急いでて、\n書き忘れちゃったのかな
traducao: Maybe they were in such a rush\nthat they forgot to write it?

original: うん、そうかもしれないね。\n何せ…
traducao: Yes, that might be the case.\nAfter all...

original: 誘拐事件の被害者と犯人を\n捕まえて欲しいって内容の様だから
traducao: it asks us to capture the kidnapper\nand rescue the kidnapping victim.

original: 誘拐！？
traducao: A kidnapping?!

original: まだ、そうと決まったわけじゃないと思う。\n大事な妹さんを探して欲しいって、\nそういう依頼みたい
traducao: We don't know that for sure yet.\nIt just says they want us to find\ntheir precious little sister.

original: ただ……この字……
traducao: It's just... this handwriting...

original: コハク？
traducao: Kohaku?

original: う、ううん。\n何でもないの
traducao: N-No,\nit's nothing.

original: とにかく、内容が内容だし\n一応、依頼は登録しておくけれど
traducao: Anyway, given the circumstances,\nI'll register the request for now,

original: 目的地は明記されていても、\n肝心の妹さんや\n依頼人の名前が無いんじゃ……
traducao: even if the destination is clear,\nwithout the name of the sister\nor the client...

original: アンジュ。\nその依頼、オレが行くよ
traducao: Ange,\nI'll take on that request!

original: いつもジィちゃんに\n「人が困ってたらなるべく助けろ」\nって言われてるからね
traducao: Grandpa always told me,\n"Help people whenever they're in need,"\nafter all!

original: そうね……
traducao: I suppose so...

original: ○○、良かったら\n力を貸してもらえない？
traducao: ○○, would you mind\nlending us a hand?

original: カダイフ砂漠なら、あなたも行った事が\nある場所だと思うし
traducao: Cadaif Desert is a place\nI believe you've visited before,

original: こういう場合、土地勘のある人間は\n一人でも多い方がいいと思うの
traducao: and having someone familiar\nwith the area will surely help.

original: うん。\nオレからもお願いするよ、\n○○
traducao: Yeah.\nI'm asking you as well,\n○○!

original: クエスト「謎の捜索願」が\nエントリーされました。\nクエストカウンタから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "Mysterious Missing Report"\nhas been added.\nYou can accept it at the Quest Counter.

original: ○○、手伝ってくれるんだね
traducao: ○○, you're going to help us!

original: そう来なくっちゃ！
traducao: That's the spirit!

original: ねえ、シング……
traducao: Hey, Shing...

original: この依頼人の事……、\nシングは、どう思う？
traducao: About this client...\nwhat do you think, Shing?

original: えっ、どうって？\nとっても妹思いのいい人なんだなぁって\n思うけど……
traducao: Huh, what do I think?\nI think they're a really good person\nwho cares deeply about their sister...

original: それが、どうかした？
traducao: Why do you ask?

original: ええと……。\nううん、やっぱり何でもない
traducao: Well...\nNo, never mind after all.

original: ごめんね。\n変な事聞いちゃって
traducao: Sorry.\nI shouldn't have asked.

original: 目的地は、カダイフ砂漠……だったよね。\n気を付けて行こう
traducao: Our destination is Cadaif Desert, right?\nLet's be careful out there.

original: うん
traducao: Yeah.

original: 妹さんを、必ず助けだそう！
traducao: Let's definitely save that sister!

original: この砂漠のどこかに\n誘拐された妹さんが……
traducao: Somewhere in this desert is\nthe kidnapped little sister...

original: 早く見つけてあげないと！
traducao: We've got to find her quickly!

original: うん
traducao: Yeah.

original: そうだね……
traducao: That's true...

original: えっ？
traducao: Huh?

original: 大丈夫。\nわたしは元気だよ
traducao: I'm fine.\nI'm doing okay!

original: ……とにかく、先に進んでみよう？
traducao: ...Anyway, let's keep moving forward.

original: よーし、ガンドコ行こう！
traducao: All right, let's go Gandoko!

original: それにしても、誘拐犯って\nどんな奴なんだろう？
traducao: Still, what kind of person\nis this kidnapper, I wonder?

original: そうだね……
traducao: That's true...

original: いつもぶっきらぼうでツンツンしてるけど\nほんとは照れ屋で、過保護番長で\nカナヅチ……とか？
traducao: Someone blunt and prickly,\nsecretly shy, overly protective,\nand sinks like a hammer... maybe?

original: カナヅチ……？
traducao: A hammer...?

original: それってまさか……
traducao: Wait, does that mean...

original: シング、ごめんね。\n騙してたわけじゃないんだけど
traducao: I'm sorry, Shing.\nI wasn't trying to deceive you, but

original: あの神経質な文字、もしかしたらって……
traducao: that uptight handwriting made me think...

original: 大工さんだよね！\nそうか、誘拐犯は大工……！！
traducao: A carpenter, right!\nSo the kidnapper is a carpenter...!!

original: じゃあ、妹さんは\n大工の跡取り問題に巻き込まれて……！？
traducao: Then the little sister was caught up\nin a carpenter succession dispute...?!

original: シング……
traducao: Shing...

original: そのカナヅチじゃなくて
traducao: Not that kind of hammer.

original: え？
traducao: Eh?

original: はぁはぁ……。\nすごい陽射しだなぁ……
traducao: *pant, pant*...\nThe sunlight is so intense...

original: コハク、大丈夫？
traducao: Kohaku, are you alright?

original: うん、シング……きゃっ
traducao: Yeah, Shing... Eek!

original: コハク！
traducao: Kohaku!

original: ありがとう、シング……
traducao: Thank you, Shing...

original: くおぉら、コハクに近寄るんじゃねえ！！
traducao: Hey you! Get away from Kohaku!!

original: やっと見つけたぜ！
traducao: I finally found you!

original: コハク、もう大丈夫だ。\n兄ちゃんが付いてるからな
traducao: Kohaku, you're safe now.\nYour big brother is here!

original: ヒスイ……！\nどうしてこんな所に？
traducao: Hisui...!\nWhat are you doing here?

original: どうしてだと？\nへっ。\nわかりきった事聞くんじゃねえ
traducao: What am I doing?\nHeh.\nDon't ask such obvious questions!

original: 不逞の輩の魔の手から、可愛い妹を\n助けに来たに決まってんだろうが
traducao: I came to save my cute sister from\nthe clutches of some scoundrel!

original: ふていの……？
traducao: A scound...?

original: もう、お兄ちゃん！\nシングはそんなんじゃないよ！
traducao: Geez, Brother!\nShing isn't like that at all!

original: ギルドに変な依頼を出したのも\n……お兄ちゃんだね？
traducao: And that weird guild request...\nwas from you too, Brother?

original: 変とは何だ、変とは！
traducao: What do you mean "weird"?!

original: 兄が妹を心配する。\nごく当たり前の事じゃねぇか
traducao: A brother worrying about his sister.\nIt's only natural!

original: 字を見てまさかとは思ったけど……。\nもう……ほんと、恥ずかしい
traducao: I suspected it from your handwriting...\nOh, honestly... I'm so embarrassed!

original: よくわからないけど……。\nあの名無しの依頼人は、\nヒスイだったんだね？
traducao: I don't really get it, but...\nthat anonymous client was actually\nHisui all along?

original: じゃあこれで、一件落着だね！
traducao: Then that settles it, case closed!

original: ちょっと待て。\nどこが一件落着なんだよ
traducao: Hold on a second!\nHow is the case closed?!

original: だって、この通り\nコハクはオレが全力で、しっかり！\n守ってるからさ！！
traducao: Because as you can see,\nI'm protecting Kohaku with all my\nmight, safe and sound!!

original: だから、それが全力で\n心配だって言ってんだッ！
traducao: And that's precisely why I'm\nworried with all my might!!

original: ……もう、お兄ちゃん！？
traducao: ...Geez, Brother?!

original: 喧嘩はダメって……、\nいつも言ってるよね？
traducao: Didn't I tell you...\nno fighting?

original: （相変わらず\n　コハクの蹴りはすごいなぁ……）
traducao: (As usual,\nKohaku's kick is incredible...)

original: とにかく、これで依頼は達成だね
traducao: Anyway, this completes the request.

original: ねえ、○○。\nお兄ちゃんもこのまま\nギルドに連れて行ってもいいかな？
traducao: Hey, ○○.\nCan we take Brother back to\nthe guild with us like this?

original: さすがに砂漠に置いて行ったら、\nカラカラのシワシワに\nなっちゃいそうで……
traducao: If we leave him behind in the desert,\nhe'll shrivel up like a prune\nand dry out completely...

original: うん、そうだね。\nひとまずバンエルティア号に戻ろう
traducao: Yeah, that's true.\nLet's head back to the Van Eltia for now.

original: 痛っててて……
traducao: Ow, ow, ow, ouch...

original: うう、コハクの蹴りは五臓六腑に\n染み渡る強烈さだぜ……
traducao: Ugh, Kohaku's kick hits you\nright in the gut, piercing through...

original: それもこれもシングのアホが……
traducao: And it's all that idiot Shing's fault...

original: お兄ちゃん、何か言った？
traducao: Brother, did you say something?

original: いやぁ、シングも立派に成長したなぁ！\nはは、はははははははは！
traducao: N-No, Shing has grown into a fine man!\nHa, hahahahahaha!

original: でも、良かった。\nこれで、今日からヒスイも\nオレ達の仲間だね！
traducao: I'm glad, though.\nThat means starting today, Hisui,\nyou're one of our comrades too!

original: あぁ？\nいつ俺がお前の仲間になったんだ？
traducao: Huh?\nSince when did I become your comrade?

original: じゃあ、今から帰るの？
traducao: Then are you going home right now?

original: ぐっ……
traducao: Urk...

original: か、帰るわけねーだろ！\nてめぇとコハクを二人っきりになんて\n絶対させねえ！！
traducao: A-As if I'd go back!\nI'll never leave you alone with Kohaku,\nnot in a million years!!

original: じゃあ、決まりだね
traducao: Then it's settled!

original: 今日からよろしく、ヒスイ！
traducao: Glad to have you with us, Hisui!

original: お、おう……？
traducao: Y-Yeah...?

original: うん。\nみんなで協力していこう
traducao: Yeah.\nLet's all work together.

original: ○○も、\n手伝って欲しい事があったら\nいつでも呼んでね
traducao: ○○,\nif you ever need any help,\nfeel free to call on us anytime.

original: こう見えてお兄ちゃんも\n結構頼りになるんだよ
traducao: Despite how he looks,\nBrother can actually be pretty reliable.

original: そうそう
traducao: That's right!

original: 枯れ木も山の賑わい……ってね！
traducao: Even a dead tree adds to the scenery...!

original: てめぇ！！\n意味わかって言ってんのか！？
traducao: You bastard!!\nDo you even know what that means?!

original: あ、あれ……何か違った？
traducao: H-Huh...? Did I say something wrong?

original: ヒスイがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Hisui joined Ad Libitum.
